title: hedyotis hygrophila
intro: Hedyotis hygrophila, commonly known as Rohida, is a type of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in various medicinal practices, particularly in Ayurvedic and Unani medicine, to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Hedyotis hygrophila include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help reduce fever, alleviate digestive issues, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects.
